title: [review] provisioning.py:367: Access to private _provis
description: The fallback `br_session._provisioned_seed` accesses an internal attribute of BRProvisioningSession. The comment claims the crypto layer guarantees this is set after decrypt_ack(), but this relies on undocumented internal behavior. If BRProvisioningSession changes its internal structure (renames field, uses a different state representation), this code breaks silently. Consider exposing a public accessor or passing the seed explicitly through the session wrapper.
